final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). For each such entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required format, extracted the service, level (uppercased), message (text after the service name on the first line), and the last line of the traceback if present (or null if no traceback). I also summed the repeat counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. Finally, I aggregated the counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure.
